item.description:
New

  • Answer Claude Code's AskUserQuestion prompts from your iPhone while away—select single or multiple options, enter a custom answer, or decline, verified with Face ID.
  • Approve requests locally on the same network when connected via iCloud without scanning a QR code, with each Mac using its own credentials when multiple Macs share an iCloud account.

Improved

  • Show the project, session title, request, and reply summary for Inbox items consistently across the Mac Inbox window and iPhone.
  • Automatically turn on iPhone Link when enabling Remote Connection or Approve on iPhone when away if iPhone Link has never been configured, and warn when iPhone Link is turned off.
  • Show App Store region availability for the iPhone app under Settings › iPhone Link.

Fixed

  • Fix Needs you items and pending approval cards on iPhone not refreshing automatically after you handle them in your Mac terminal.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
  • Answering Claude Code questions from iPhone requires Melora Companion 1.1.1 for iPhone (Face ID), which is coming to the App Store shortly.
